OriginalScript: Heavy rain’s anticipated, and the Adelaide Hills roads could be affected. South Road is closed at Sir Donald Bradman Drive for Torrens to Darlington civil works, and it’s also closed at James Congdon Drive. Main North Road is under speed with roadworks. Anzac Highway at Morphett Road, Old Port Road at Tapleys Hill Road, Marion Road at Winifred Avenue, Port Wakefield Road at Grand Junction Road and Salisbury Highway at Shepherdson Road are all a touch slow through construction.
